title: Sheehan represented John Mack and vetted experiencers

tellings.quote: well I I represented him for 10 years uh and uh met dozens of people uh that he had worked with

plain: Dan Sheehan, a lawyer, says he represented John Mack, a Harvard psychiatrist who studied people reporting encounters with aliens, for about ten years starting around 1990. Over that time, Sheehan tells Michels, he met dozens of the people Mack had worked with, the so-called experiencers who say they have had such contact, and sized them up himself. He offers this as someone who took part, and it would mean Mack's subjects were checked by an outsider as well as by Mack.
